verdict.rationale: WezTerm's feature docs list Searchable Scrollback, with Ctrl-Shift-F opening search mode and Shift-PageUp/PageDown or the mouse wheel for navigating scrollback. Quick Select adds fast pattern-based highlighting and selection of on-screen matches, and a long-time user reports using the copy modes constantly. missing for 10: explicit documentation of next/previous match navigation within search mode, independent hands-on corroboration of search speed and match-jumping.
